subject: Legacy vendor invoice format + Net terms migration
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@legacycorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@legacycorp.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Oct 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding: invoice format / PO placement / billing cadence

Hi Marissa / Karthik,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We are getting our accounting team ready to send the first monthly invoice to Redwood and had a couple of process questions before we register in your vendor portal. Please see attached a sample invoice (Sample_Invoice_#4521.pdf) and our W9.

A few items we need to align on:
- PO placement: our ERP usually prints the PO on the invoice header; what exact field does Redwood require for 3-way PO matching (PO number in ‘Invoice reference’ vs ‘PO number’)?
- Invoice transmission: does Redwood prefer invoices via vendor portal upload, SFTP flat files (CSV/EDIFACT), or emailed PDF to AP?
- Billing cadence & terms: LegacyCorp historically bills month-end net60. We’d like to discuss migrating to Net45 to match Redwood’s preferred cycles. If Net45 isn’t possible, would Redwood consider an early-pay option (e.g., 1.5% for payment within 10 days) to support cashflow?
- Remittance: who should we address for remittance / bank details questions?

We plan to submit the vendor intake form by Friday once we confirm the PO and transmission details. Appreciate any guidance and the relevant intake link / checklist.

Thanks,
Laura Chen
Vendor Ops | LegacyCorp
attachments: LegacyCorp_W9.pdf, Sample_Invoice_#4521.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@legacycorp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Oct 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: invoice format / PO placement / billing cadence

Laura — thanks for the attachments and the clear list. Looping in Karthik (procurement) and Rishi (finance) to confirm the fine details; below are the immediate answers and next steps so we don’t block your intake.

Quick answers:
- PO placement: for automated matching please ensure the PO number is in the PO Number field (visible on the top-right header) and also in the invoice line-level reference if the invoice contains multiple POs. If your ERP only allows a single header field, the header PO is sufficient.
- Transmission: vendor portal upload is preferred (single source of truth). We can accept emailed PDFs temporarily but please confirm portal registration within 7 business days. If you have EDI/flat-file capability, we can map fields later — let Karthik know.
- Billing cadence & terms: Redwood’s standard for newly activated vendors is Net45. We can discuss an early-pay pilot — tagging Rishi here for details.
- Remittance: AP emails to ap-team@redwood.com; wire details come to treasury@redwood.com (we'll request them after vendor banking verification).

Next steps (to keep the onboarding moving):
1) Complete the vendor intake form here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/legacycorp-onboard (please upload W9 there as well).
2) Karthik to confirm whether LegacyCorp will submit invoices as PDFs or via SFTP/EDI; if PDF, confirm invoice file naming convention (we prefer Redwood_PO-{po}_{invoice}.pdf).
3) Rishi to confirm early-pay program terms and the internal approval process (if any).

Karthik / Rishi — can you confirm the EDI mapping window and whether we can make an exception to Net45 for LegacyCorp to move to Net30 or an early-pay pilot?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@legacycorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Oct 2027 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: invoice format / PO placement / billing cadence

Laura / Marissa —

Thanks — a few procurement-specific items to make PO matching and month-end close painless:
- If you will submit PDFs: include the PO number in the invoice filename and in the header. Our AP system performs header-level matching; line-level is only used when multiple POs are present.
- If you have EDI/flat-file capability we can map the following mandatory fields: invoice_date, invoice_number, po_number, remit_to_code, line_amount, tax_amount. If you want to explore EDI integration, we can provision an SFTP staging area and share a sample schema.
- Regarding cadence: Redwood prefers monthly cut-off on the 25th to align with our close; vendors that bill on month-end can expect slight shifts. If LegacyCorp needs strict month-end billing, please call that out in the intake form so we can gate PO timing.

Early-pay / Net migration ask: we have a short runway to align LegacyCorp to Net45. However, procurement can approve vendor-specific cadence adjustments when it impacts delivery economics. For any early-pay pilot we require:
  * Signed early-pay participation form (we use the short pilot agreement)
  * Three months of invoices in the intake packet to validate cadence
  * Confirmation of remittance bank details and ACH test successful

Please confirm whether LegacyCorp can upload the previous three invoices to the intake folder. I’ve created a ticket to track this: PROC-842 (link above). Once Rishi approves terms we’ll finalize.

Karthik Iyer
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
attachments: Vendor_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@legacycorp.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Oct 2027 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: invoice format / PO placement / billing cadence

Hi all —

After a quick review with treasury, finance can approve an early-pay pilot for LegacyCorp under these conditions:
- Pilot: first 3 invoices after activation; Redwood will offer net settlement within 10 calendar days for a 2% early-payment discount.
- Required docs: completed vendor intake form, W9 (received), three most recent invoices uploaded to the intake folder, and completed bank verification (ACH micro-deposit or bank letter).
- AP routing: invoices must be sent to ap-team@redwood.com with the subject line: Invoice | LegacyCorp | PO-{po_number}. If we receive unmatched invoices we will queue them for manual review and payment will be delayed.

LegacyCorp — if you accept the pilot, please:
1) Upload the three invoices and the signed pilot agreement to https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/legacycorp-onboard
2) Confirm whether you will use portal upload or SFTP for daily invoice delivery
3) Send bank verification to treasury@redwood.com (or confirm ACH micro-deposit option)

Once we receive the items above we will provision your vendor record, issue the first PO(s), and start the pilot. If anything changes on your side (different billing cadence or consolidated invoices), flag it here and we’ll evaluate.

Best regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Finance | Redwood Inference
